Title: General availability: Citus 11 support for Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Hyperscale (Citus)

Body.Content: The latest Citus 11 version for Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) allows data-intense apps to query any node in your server group, creates new ways to monitor a distributed Postgres database, and more. You can get Citus 11 today by creating a new Hyperscale (Citus) server group or by upgrading an existing one running PostgreSQL 14. Learn more about supported PostgreSQL and Citus versions and upgrading to the latest PostgreSQL and Citus.
